chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Verily, Allah, the Exalted, did not prescribe for women a Qada (make-up) of fasting, nor a make-up of fasting other than that of Ramadan, unless it is a vow or a fasting expiation or a voluntary fasting.
ai.seo_question: Do women need to make up missed fasts from Ramadan?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the juristic consensus that obligatory fasts (*Fard*) missed due to valid excuses like menstruation or postpartum bleeding do not require *Qada* (making up) unless tied to a specific vow or expiation. This ruling distinguishes the general obligation of Ramadan fasting from conditional obligations, reflecting the Shia emphasis on ease (*Yusr*) in ritual law while maintaining strict adherence to the conditions of *Nadhr* and *Kaffarah*.
